input.summary: Insert Contractor IP indemnity as new Section 7(d) with customary exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap that overrides the 7(a) cap.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no Contractor indemnity at all, so we have added our fallback position: a third-party IP infringement indemnity with the usual Company-modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, and a super-cap of three times annual fees that applies in place of the Section 7(a) cap.

ops.text: (d) Contractor shall indemnify Company against any third-party claim that the Services or Works infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, except to the extent the claim arises from Company's modification of the Services or Works, from combination of the Services or Works with items not supplied by Contractor, or from Company's written specifications. For any such claim, Contractor shall procure for Company the right to continue using the affected item, or modify or replace it so that it is non-infringing, and if none of those remedies is commercially available, Contractor shall refund the fees paid for the affected item. Notwithstanding Paragraph 7(a), Contractor's aggregate liability under this Paragraph 7(d) shall not exceed three times (3x) the annual fees paid to Contractor under this Agreement.
